**Question**

(b) Give three features shared by the members of a homologous series. [3]

**Question**

(a) Describe how the scientist should set up and run the chromatogram. [3]

(b) The results are shown in the table.

| Sample | Distance of each spot from the baseline / cm |
|---|---|
| E | 2.1 and 5.4 |
| P | 2.1 |
| Q | 3.8 |
| R | 5.4 |
| S | 2.1 and 6.7 |

(i) Deduce which of the known dyes P, Q, R and S are present in E. Explain your answer. [2]

(ii) State which one of the known dyes P, Q, R and S is not a pure substance. [1]

(c) A load of hematite contains 480 kg of iron(III) oxide.

Calculate the maximum mass of iron, in kg, that can be produced from this iron(III) oxide.

[Ar: Fe = 56; O = 16] [2]

**Question**

| metal | observations with cold water | observations with dilute hydrochloric acid |
|---|---|---|
| P | no reaction | slow bubbling |
| R | fizzes steadily | not tested (too dangerous) |
| T | no reaction | no reaction |
| V | no reaction | rapid bubbling |

What is the order of reactivity of the metals, from most reactive to least reactive?

A R, P, V, T
B V, R, P, T
C R, V, P, T
D T, P, V, R
